Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of QCOM.
We delivered record revenue of $12.8 billion this quarter, representing 12% year-over-year growth.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2021.
Our cloud segment grew 12% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Revenue guidance of $12.8 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We generated $2.2 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 12% to 19% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
